evidence: Native single-crystal comparison with one published wind-tunnel fit; empirical discrepancy, initialization and numerical refinement are distinct from snow-population validation.

source.units: Table mass g, full a/c lengths mm, age minutes; all outputs SI.
source.limits: Published fits lack pointwise measurement errors. Planar thickness was inferred from mass and basal area. No aggregates or riming are represented by this selected curve. Corrigendum replaces Fig. 3, not Table 2.

settings.name: growth_earth_observed_dt10
settings.forcing: Stationary isolated crystals; terminal-speed ventilation, constant T,p,e, no injection, collisions, liquid, melting, or transport. Unlimited in practice deposition ceiling verified from ledger.
settings.unmatched: Empirical fit at one Earth laboratory temperature, starting at three minutes. Initial mass and full axes map to a porous spheroid; observed thickness is inferred from mass and area. Spherical control preserves initial mass and maximum dimension. Moon run is an unvalidated gravity sensitivity at the same laboratory air state.
settings.ledger_convention: Native hook assumes an empty initial population. Its raw residual therefore equals the known initial ice mass per area; independently add initial_water_kg_m2 to its source side.
